headline: JSA, Verist Law, Duane Morris & Selvam act on Manorama Industries ₹500 crore QIP
sum: Manorama Industries Limited has raised ₹500 crores from institutional buyers including WhiteOak, Goldman Sachs (Maurititus) and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority through a Qualified Institutional Placement. JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised…
detail: Manorama Industries Limited has raised ₹500 crores from institutional buyers including WhiteOak, Goldman Sachs (Maurititus) and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority through a Qualified Institutional Placement. JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised Manorama Industries on this QIP. Verist Law advised book-running lead managers Ambit Private Limited and ITI Capital Limited on this QIP. The transaction team consisted of Srishti Ojha (Founding Partner), Iti Mishra (Principal Associate), Associates Dhruv Chopra and Rahul Jacob.
